product.audience: International buyers and design patrons evaluating one site-specific coastal residence
product.decision: Understand spatial sequence, daylight, programme and acquisition fit
product.conversion: Build a private visit brief and request a viewing

signature.moment: A scroll-linked 3D cutaway villa travels from arrival court through living void and water court to the roof horizon while sun angle and room dossier update

systems.hero: A live architectural section occupies the full first fold with a marginal address ledger rather than a photographic property hero
systems.navigation: Vertical floor-coordinate rail on desktop; compact room itinerary on mobile
systems.contentDensity: Spatially quiet 3D scenes alternate with dense architect-style room and environmental data
systems.geometry: Section cuts, datum lines, sun arcs, level markers, courtyard voids and long landscape plans
systems.motion: Bounded scroll changes camera position, section cut and sun angle; explicit room and daylight controls provide non-scroll equivalents
systems.coreInteraction: Visitors travel through four architectural coordinates, inspect sun conditions and room programme, then assemble a visit brief

structuralDifferences: The live model becomes a square sectional viewport followed by the current room card
Scroll choreography is replaced by four explicit coordinate buttons
The horizontal site plan becomes a vertical level stack
Visit preferences remain an inline itinerary ticket rather than a booking drawer

artDirection.typography: Architectural grotesk with narrow level numbers and restrained serif site notes
artDirection.material: Chalk concrete, smoked glass, oxidised bronze, ocean blue and sun-washed sand
artDirection.imageLogic: The residence and landscape are code-native 3D geometry; plans, sun diagrams and material sections are SVG/CSS
artDirection.microcopy: Datum, court, aperture, thermal mass, sea axis, programme, level and private visit language
artDirection.dataHonesty: Area, climate, availability and site facts are labelled as fictional sample development data

adjacentTemplates.why: FORMA is a panoramic portfolio and project index; this is a single-residence 3D sectional promenade and visit brief.
This fixed architectural journey changes camera and daylight rather than configuring furniture dimensions and placement.
A sectional model and architect itinerary replace conventional listing imagery, amenity cards and enquiry patterns.
No resort portals, room collection or reservation drawer; the residence is explored as one continuous section.
The camera travels through a spatial model, not cinematic hotel frames or booking overlays.
